items.caption: A small-seal form of 左, shown here as a modern redraw. It offers a later graphic comparison for the early form interpreted as a left hand; it does not resolve the debated role of 工 in later bronze forms.
items.alt: Black strokes of 左 in small-seal style on a white background.
items.selection_reason: This identifiable form provides a useful comparison with the reported early 𠂇 form, while making clear that it is a modern redraw rather than an ancient inscription.

limitations.text: This redraw is not a dated artifact image, so it cannot establish when this form appeared or how it relates chronologically to individual early and bronze examples.
